> 第336章 造化使者（第1页）
“那好，我师伯们既然应了，便可以算是真正的‘造化使者’了。”
苏白尘随之解释：“我发现其实我们天尊早就在仙宫的权柄体系中留下了一些位置，而这些位置同样可以一定程度借用仙宫中那庞大的生命灵气。”
与此同时，陆青峰还在考虑着，能不能将三人灵魂中留下的天妖烙印去除掉，一旦做到了，自己的星域就无形中多出了三个天帝。
转眼一天时间过去，当6青峰服用了三十粒养魂丹后，已经没有了任何效果，想要灵魂完全恢复，就必须要借助空间图中的养魂潭。
猿金星怒目圆睁，迈步朝着猿金海走去，每迈出一步，手中的金色大棍就明亮一分，逐渐的向棍体中灌注神力。
所以，他怒归怒，还是不敢发泄，目前来说，陈方是他唯一存在可能的救命稻草。
九团分魂尽管和主魂分裂，但在感觉之上，却根本无分彼此，依旧是一个整体的。
杜明见状也只好摇头苦笑，在李如瑶身边的位置坐下后，示意我也坐下。
他们或多或少，都知道纯阳至尊口中所说的永恒神树，其实便是现在永恒元洞中的永恒树祖灵，至于另一个永恒仙藤，就没听说过了。
秋通不管三七二十一，逍遥流星步法施展，带着绿儿一阵狂奔，后边的裂天豹是以速度著称的，可是竟然怎么都追不上神通，追了一阵终于是放弃了，秋通这才长长舒了口气。
战前，袁军还有八千多兵力，现在却只剩下四千不到了，还有大量的伤员。
对于她的处境我有些同情，可是我也没办法，我也不是她父亲，也不是她的家人，我没有办法去阻止她婚姻的道路。
“滚犊子，你把我想成什么人了，不过他家没人，为啥叫我去，还说什么特别恐怖的事，这就让我很郁闷了，”我点了支烟深吸了口说道。
这两天，洛恩一直都住在二楼关心瞳住过的房间，他吃的很少，也从不出门，这样的状态让人十分担心。
“少给我俩整没用的，进来吧，”哥们杵着墩布看着屈舒言说道。
这里犹如一道天然分界线，过了鹰嘴峰就算是出了六芒山主峰地域。车刚行过此处，西门靖的手机忽然抽风一样响了起来。
看样子，只有先解开慧觉禅师的毒，才有可能解开赵天歌的脑域禁制了。
“你要是出不来的话，就不要勉强自己，翻墙是很危险的。”我板着脸道。

又陷入柔软的被子之中，关心瞳只觉得眼皮有千斤重，脸不自觉的扭过一边，身体完全失去意识一样动也不动。
第二天早上，颜诗语从床上醒来。清晨的阳光温暖而柔和而她却觉得阳光照在自己脸上火辣辣地。
见梁善竟然无视她直接向外面走去，柳金香一阵发愣后气急败坏地道。
好在从操场到停车场的路没有多远，西门还能活着走过去，还真不容易。
“无妨。”此刻姜暖心情正好，也懒得和他计较。更何况不管是现代还是古代，看人下菜碟儿本就是俗人的通病，任谁也治不了。她索性大方点，也省的怄气。
“一百两。这是看着公子投缘才说的数目。不二价。”缓缓抬头，姜暖直视着那青年。桌布下的手却是用力地绞着自己衣襟。

> Chapter 336 Messenger of Creation (Page 1)
"Well, since my uncles have agreed, they can be regarded as true 'messengers of creation'."
Su Baichen then explained: "I discovered that our Heavenly Lord has actually left some positions in the authority system of the Immortal Palace, and these positions can also borrow the huge life aura in the Immortal Palace to a certain extent."
At the same time, Lu Qingfeng was still thinking about whether he could remove the mark of the Heavenly Demon left in the souls of the three people. Once he did it, there would be three more Heavenly Emperors in his star field.
A day passed in the blink of an eye. After Lu Qingfeng took thirty soul-nourishing pills, there was no effect anymore. If he wanted to fully recover his soul, he had to use the soul-nourishing pool in the space map.
Yuan Jinxing's eyes widened in anger, and he walked towards Yuan Jinhai. With every step he took, the golden stick in his hand became brighter, and divine power was gradually poured into the stick.
Therefore, he was angry and still didn't dare to vent. For now, Chen Fang was his only possible life-saving straw.
Although the nine divided souls are separated from the main soul, in terms of feeling, they are not separated from each other at all and are still a whole.
When Du Ming saw this, he could only shake his head and smile bitterly. After sitting down next to Li Ruyao, he motioned for me to sit down too.
More or less, they all knew that the eternal sacred tree mentioned by Chunyang Supreme was actually the ancestral spirit of the eternal tree in the eternal Yuan Cave. As for the other eternal immortal vine, they had never heard of it.
Qiutong didn't care, he used Xiaoyao Meteor's footwork, and led Lu'er to run wildly. The Sky-Splitting Leopard behind was famous for its speed, but it couldn't catch up with Shen Tong. After chasing for a while, he finally gave up, and Qiutong let out a long sigh of relief.
Before the war, Yuan Jun still had more than 8,000 troops, but now he only had less than 4,000 troops left, and there were still a large number of wounded.
I have some sympathy for her situation, but there is nothing I can do. I am not her father or her family, and there is nothing I can do to stop her marriage.
"Fuck you, who do you think I am? But there is no one at home, so why did he ask me to go and say something terrible? This makes me very depressed," I lit a cigarette and took a deep breath.
For the past two days, Lorne has been living in the room where Caring Tong lived on the second floor. He eats very little and never goes out. This state of affairs is very worrying.
"Don't bother us two. Come in," the brother said while holding the cloth and looking at Qu Shuyan.
This is like a natural dividing line. After passing Yingzui Peak, you are out of the main peak area of ​​Liumang Mountain. Just as the car passed by, Ximen Jing's cell phone suddenly rang like a convulsion.
It seems that only by undoing Zen Master Huijue's poison first can it be possible to unblock Zhao Tiange's brain domain.
"If you can't get out, don't force yourself. It's very dangerous to climb over the wall." I said with a straight face.
She fell into the soft quilt again. Caring Tong felt that her eyelids were as heavy as a thousand pounds. Her face turned to the side unconsciously, and her body was completely unconscious and motionless.
The next morning, Yan Shiyu woke up from bed. The morning sun was warm and soft, but she felt it was burning on her face.
Seeing that Liang Shan ignored her and walked directly outside, Liu Jinxiang was stunned for a while and then said angrily.
Fortunately, the road from the playground to the parking lot is not very far. It is not easy for Ximen to walk there alive.
"It doesn't matter." Jiang Nuan was in a good mood at the moment and didn't bother to argue with him. What's more, regardless of whether it's modern or ancient times, it's a common problem among ordinary people to look at other people's food, and no one can cure it. She could simply be more generous and save herself from getting upset.
"One hundred taels. This is the amount I only mentioned after seeing the young master fall in love. No two prices." Jiang Nuan slowly raised his head and looked directly at the young man. The hands under the tablecloth areHe was twisting his clothes hard.
